cn: v. 放弃，遗弃；n. 放任，狂热
en: to leave a place, thing, or person forever; to stop doing an activity before finishing it
ex_en: They had to abandon their car in the deep snow.
ex_cn: 他们不得不把车弃置在厚厚的积雪中。
tip: 词根：a(不)+band(布条/束缚)+on → 解开束缚任其远去 → 放弃，遗弃

cn: adj. 抽象的；n. 摘要，梗概；v. 提取，做摘要
en: existing in thought or as an idea but not having a physical or concrete existence
ex_en: Please write a 200-word abstract for your research paper.
ex_cn: 请为你的研究论文写一份200字的摘要。
tip: 词根：abs(离开)+tract(拉、抽) → 从具体事物中抽离出来 → 抽象的；摘要

cn: v. 积累，积聚，堆积
en: to gather or acquire an increasing number or quantity of something over time
ex_en: Dust quickly accumulates if a room is not cleaned regularly.
ex_cn: 如果房间不定期打扫，灰尘很快就会积聚起来。
tip: 词根：ac(表加强)+cumul(堆积)+ate → 不断堆积 → 积累

cn: adj. 精确的，准确的，正确无误的
en: correct in all details; exact and free from error
ex_en: The meteorological station provided an accurate weather forecast.
ex_cn: 气象站提供了准确的天气预报。
tip: 词根：ac(一再)+cur(关心、注意)+ate → 一再小心核对 → 准确的

cn: v. 承认，致谢，告知收到
en: to accept or admit the existence or truth of; to express gratitude for
ex_en: She refused to acknowledge that there was a flaw in the plan.
ex_cn: 她拒绝承认计划中存在缺陷。
tip: 助记：ac(去)+knowledge(知道) → 让大家都知道 → 承认；致谢

cn: v. 获得，取得；学到，习得
en: to buy or obtain an asset or object; to learn or develop a skill or habit
ex_en: Children acquire native language skills rapidly through daily interaction.
ex_cn: 儿童通过日常互动迅速习得母语技能。
tip: 词根：ac(加强)+quir(寻求)+e → 不断寻求并拿到 → 获得，习得

cn: v. 使适应，使适合；改编，改写
en: to become adjusted to new conditions; to modify for a new use or purpose
ex_en: Organisms must adapt to shifting environmental conditions to survive.
ex_cn: 生物必须适应不断变化的环境条件才能生存。
tip: 词根：ad(趋向)+apt(适当的) → 使变得适当 → 适应；改编（注意区分 adopt 收养/采纳）

cn: adj. 充足的，足够的；适当的，胜任的
en: satisfactory or acceptable in quality or quantity
ex_en: Make sure you get adequate sleep before the final examination.
ex_cn: 期末考试前务必保证充足的睡眠。
tip: 词根：ad(去)+equ(相等)+ate → 与需求相匹配的 → 充足的，适当的

cn: v. 拥护，提倡，主张；n. 提倡者，辩护律师
en: to publicly recommend or support a particular policy or way of doing things
ex_en: Health experts advocate a balanced diet rich in vegetables and fiber.
ex_cn: 健康专家提倡富含蔬菜和纤维的均衡饮食。
tip: 词根：ad(加强)+voc(声音/喊叫)+ate → 大声疾呼支持 → 提倡，拥护

cn: v. 分配，分派，拨给（资金或资源）
en: to distribute resources or duties for a particular purpose
ex_en: The committee decided to allocate more funds to basic scientific research.
ex_cn: 委员会决定向基础科学研究拨付更多资金。
tip: 词根：al(去)+loc(地方)+ate → 把资源放到指定位置 → 分配，拨给

cn: v. 改变，更改，改动
en: to change or cause to change in character or composition, typically in a comparatively small way
ex_en: Nothing can alter the fact that we are responsible for our own choices.
ex_cn: 没有什么能改变我们必须为自己选择负责这一事实。
tip: 词根：alter(其他的) → 变成其他的样子 → 改变，改动

cn: adj. 模棱两可的，含糊不清的，有歧义的
en: open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning
ex_en: The wording of the agreement is ambiguous and needs clarification.
ex_cn: 协议的措辞模棱两可，需要进一步澄清。
tip: 词根：ambi(两边)+ig(走)+uous → 往两边都能走 → 模棱两可的

cn: v. 预期，预料；期盼；先于…行动
en: to regard as probable; to expect or predict and prepare for
ex_en: We anticipate that demand for renewable energy will continue to rise.
ex_cn: 我们预计对可再生能源的需求将继续上升。
tip: 词根：anti(前)+cip(拿/抓)+ate → 提前把握趋势 → 预期，预料

cn: adj. 显而易见的，明显的；表面上的
en: clearly visible or understood; seeming real or true, but not necessarily so
ex_en: It soon became apparent that the project needed additional engineers.
ex_cn: 很快就能明显看出该项目需要更多工程师。
tip: 词根：ap(加强)+par(显现)+ent → 显现出来的 → 明显的；表面上的

cn: v. 评估，评定；估算（价值或质量）
en: to evaluate or estimate the nature, ability, or quality of something
ex_en: Standardized tests are one way to assess students' academic progress.
ex_cn: 标准化测试是评估学生学业进步的一种方式。
tip: 词根：as(旁边)+sess(坐) → 坐在旁边评审打分 → 评估，评定

cn: v. 把…归因于；n. 属性，特质，标志
en: to regard something as being caused by; a quality or feature regarded as a characteristic
ex_en: She attributes her recovery to regular exercise and a positive mindset.
ex_cn: 她把自己的康复归功于规律的运动和积极的心态。
tip: 词根：at(去)+tribut(给予)+e → 把原因归给某事 → 归因于；属性

cn: adj. 真正的，真品的；可靠的，地道的
en: of undisputed origin and not a copy; genuine and reliable
ex_en: The museum confirmed that the ancient manuscript is completely authentic.
ex_cn: 博物馆确认这份古代手稿完全是真品。
tip: 词根：auth(自己/作者)+entic → 出自原作者亲手之作 → 真品的，地道的

cn: adj. 可获得的，可用的；有空的
en: able to be used or obtained; at someone's disposal
ex_en: All dictionaries in Voca are available offline without internet access.
ex_cn: Voca中的所有词库均可在无网络环境下离线使用。
tip: 词根：a(加强)+vail(价值/效用)+able → 能发挥效用的 → 可用的

cn: n. 障碍，壁垒；屏障，栅栏
en: a fence or other obstacle that prevents movement or access
ex_en: Language should be a bridge for communication rather than a barrier.
ex_cn: 语言应当成为沟通的桥梁，而不是障碍。
tip: 词根：bar(横木/阻挡)+rier → 挡在面前的栅栏 → 障碍，壁垒

cn: adj. 有益的，有利的，有帮助的
en: resulting in good; favorable or advantageous
ex_en: Spaced repetition is highly beneficial for long-term vocabulary retention.
ex_cn: 间隔重复对词汇的长期记忆非常有益。
tip: 词根：bene(好)+fic(做)+ial → 做出好事的 → 有益的，有利的

cn: n. 偏见，成见；偏差；v. 使有偏见
en: inclination or prejudice for or against one person or group, especially in an unfair way
ex_en: Researchers must design double-blind trials to eliminate observer bias.
ex_cn: 研究人员必须设计双盲试验以消除观察者偏差。
tip: 考研高频词：注意其学术含义“统计偏差、认知偏见”

cn: n. 容量，容积；能力，才能；身份，职位
en: the maximum amount that something can contain; the ability or power to do something
ex_en: The stadium has a seating capacity of sixty thousand spectators.
ex_cn: 这座体育场可容纳六万名观众。
tip: 词根：cap(抓、容纳)+acity → 能够容纳的量 → 容量；能力

cn: n. 催化剂；促进因素，刺激因素
en: a substance that increases the rate of a chemical reaction; a person or thing that precipitates an event
ex_en: Technological innovation acts as a catalyst for economic transformation.
ex_cn: 技术创新是经济转型的催化剂。
tip: 词根：cata(向下)+lyst(分解) → 加速化学分解之物 → 催化剂；促进因素

cn: adj. 慢性的，长期的；积习难改的
en: persisting for a long time or constantly recurring
ex_en: Lack of rest can lead to chronic fatigue and reduced concentration.
ex_cn: 缺乏休息会导致慢性疲劳和注意力下降。
tip: 词根：chron(时间)+ic → 持续很长时间的 → 慢性的，长期的

cn: v. 澄清，阐明，使清晰易懂
en: to make a statement or situation less confused and more clearly comprehensible
ex_en: Could you clarify the second point in your project proposal?
ex_cn: 你能阐明一下你项目提案中的第二点吗？
tip: 词根：clar(清楚)+ify(使…) → 使变得清楚 → 澄清，阐明

cn: adj. 连贯的，条理清楚的；一致的
en: logical and consistent; united as or forming a whole
ex_en: The essay presents a coherent argument supported by empirical data.
ex_cn: 这篇论文提出了一个由实证数据支撑的条理清晰的论点。
tip: 词根：co(共同)+her(粘附)+ent → 紧密粘合在一起 → 连贯的，有条理的

cn: v. 同时发生；相符，一致；位置重合
en: to occur at or during the same time; to correspond in nature or in position
ex_en: His business trip happened to coincide with the international book fair.
ex_cn: 他的出差恰好与国际书展同时进行。
tip: 词根：co(共同)+in(进入)+cide(落下) → 落到同一个点上 → 同时发生；相符

cn: v./n. 倒塌，坍塌；崩溃，瓦解；暴跌
en: to fall down or give way suddenly; a sudden failure of an institution or system
ex_en: Negotiations were on the verge of collapse before the new compromise.
ex_cn: 在达成新妥协之前，谈判曾濒临破裂。
tip: 词根：col(共同)+laps(滑落)+e → 全部滑落下来 → 倒塌，崩溃

cn: n. 同事，同僚
en: a person with whom one works in a profession or business
ex_en: She discussed the new software architecture with her senior colleagues.
ex_cn: 她与资深同事们讨论了新的软件架构。
tip: 词根：col(共同)+leag(选择/选派)+ue → 被选派到一起工作的人 → 同事

cn: v. 补偿，赔偿；弥补，抵消
en: to give someone something, typically money, in recognition of loss, suffering, or injury
ex_en: Hard work and systematic methods can compensate for a lack of experience.
ex_cn: 努力工作和系统的方法可以弥补经验的不足。
tip: 词根：com(全部)+pens(称重/花费)+ate → 把失去的分量补齐 → 补偿，弥补

cn: v. 汇编，编纂；编译（代码）；搜集（资料）
en: to produce a list or book by assembling information collected from other sources; to convert source code into machine code
ex_en: It took the lexicographers five years to compile this bilingual dictionary.
ex_cn: 词典编纂者花了五年时间才编成这部双语词典。
tip: 词根：com(一起)+pil(堆积)+e → 搜集堆放到一起 → 汇编；编译

cn: v. 补充，补足，使完善；n. 补充物，补语
en: a thing that contributes extra features to something else in such a way as to improve or emphasize its quality
ex_en: Listening dictation and spelling tests complement each other in word learning.
ex_cn: 在单词学习中，听写训练和拼写测试相辅相成。
tip: 注意区分：complement（补充，e=complete完善）vs compliment（赞美，i=我夸你）

cn: adj. 全面的，综合的，详尽的
en: including or dealing with all or nearly all elements or aspects of something
ex_en: We conducted a comprehensive review of the existing software architecture.
ex_cn: 我们对现有软件架构进行了全面深入的审查。
tip: 词根：com(全部)+prehens(抓住)+ive → 把所有方面都抓在手里 → 全面的，综合的

cn: n./v. 妥协，折中；v. 危及，损害（原则或安全）
en: an agreement reached by each side making concessions; to weaken or harm by accepting standards that are lower than desirable
ex_en: We must never compromise data reliability for the sake of rapid delivery.
ex_cn: 我们绝不能为了快速交付而牺牲数据的可靠性。
tip: 考研熟词僻义：除“妥协”外，考研常考动词义“危及、损害（名誉/安全/原则）”

cn: v. 构想，设想；怀孕；心怀（某种情感）
en: to form or devise a plan or idea in the mind
ex_en: It is difficult to conceive of modern life without portable computing devices.
ex_cn: 很难设想没有便携式计算设备的现代生活会是什么样。
tip: 词根：con(共同)+ceiv(拿、抓) → 在脑海里抓取形成概念 → 构想，设想

cn: v. 集中（注意力），全神贯注；浓缩；n. 浓缩物
en: to focus all one's attention on a particular object or activity
ex_en: A clean interface helps learners concentrate on memorizing vocabulary.
ex_cn: 简洁的界面有助于学习者集中精力记忆词汇。
tip: 词根：con(共同)+centr(中心)+ate → 聚拢到同一个中心 → 集中，专注

cn: v. 授予（学位或称号）；商讨，协商
en: to grant a title, degree, benefit, or right; to have discussions or exchange opinions
ex_en: The university will confer honorary degrees on three distinguished scientists.
ex_cn: 该大学将向三位杰出科学家授予荣誉学位。
tip: 词根：con(共同)+fer(带来) → 把意见拿到一起（商讨）；把荣誉带给某人（授予）

cn: adj. 自信的，有信心的；确信的，有把握的
en: feeling or showing certainty about something; self-assured
ex_en: Consistent daily review makes students feel confident in the examination hall.
ex_cn: 坚持每日复习能让学生在考场上充满自信。
tip: 词根：con(完全)+fid(相信)+ent → 完全相信自己的 → 自信的

cn: v. 限制，局限于；禁闭，关押；n. [pl.] 界限，范围
en: to keep or restrict someone or something within certain limits of space, scope, or time
ex_en: Please confine your remarks to the specific topic under discussion.
ex_cn: 请将你的发言限制在当前讨论的具体议题范围内。
tip: 词根：con(共同)+fin(边界)+e → 圈在边界之内 → 限制，局限于

cn: v. 证实，确认；批准；使更坚定
en: to establish the truth or correctness of something previously believed or suspected
ex_en: Experiments confirm that active recall is far more effective than passive reading.
ex_cn: 实验证实，主动回忆远比被动阅读有效得多。
tip: 词根：con(完全)+firm(坚定) → 使完全确定 → 确认，证实

cn: n. 冲突，矛盾，争执；v. 抵触，冲突
en: a serious disagreement or argument; to be incompatible or at variance
ex_en: When sources conflict, always verify against the most recent primary evidence.
ex_cn: 当信息来源发生冲突时，务必以最新的一手证据为准进行核实。
tip: 词根：con(共同)+flict(打击) → 互相撞击 → 冲突，抵触

cn: v. 遵守，遵从（规则或标准）；顺应，一致
en: to comply with rules, standards, or laws; to behave according to socially acceptable conventions
ex_en: All exported packages must conform to the platform's binary specifications.
ex_cn: 所有导出的安装包都必须符合平台的二进制规范。
tip: 词根：con(共同)+form(形状/形式) → 保持同样的形式 → 遵守，顺应

cn: v. 面临，遭遇（困难）；勇敢面对；对质
en: to come face to face with someone with hostile or argumentative intent; to deal with a difficult situation
ex_en: We must confront technical challenges directly rather than avoiding them.
ex_cn: 我们必须直面技术挑战，而不是回避它们。
tip: 词根：con(共同)+front(前额/正面) → 正面迎上去 → 面临，直面

cn: n. 共识，一致的意见
en: a general agreement among a group of people
ex_en: After a thorough discussion, the engineering team reached a consensus on the design.
ex_cn: 经过充分讨论，工程团队就设计方案达成了共识。
tip: 词根：con(共同)+sens(感觉/看法)+us → 大家看法一致 → 共识

cn: n. 结果，后果；重要性，重大意义
en: a result or effect of an action or condition; importance or relevance
ex_en: Understanding the long-term consequences of design choices is essential.
ex_cn: 理解设计决策的长远后果至关重要。
tip: 考研熟词僻义：of no consequence 意为“无关紧要、无足轻重”

cn: v. 保护，保存；节省，节约（能源或资源）
en: to protect something environmentally or culturally important from harm or destruction
ex_en: Dark mode on OLED screens helps conserve battery power on mobile devices.
ex_cn: OLED屏幕上的纯黑模式有助于节省移动设备的电池电量。
tip: 词根：con(全部)+serv(保持)+e → 完整地保存下来 → 保护，节约

cn: adj. 一致的，始终如一的；相符的，不矛盾的
en: acting or done in the same way over time; compatible or in agreement
ex_en: Both platforms must maintain a consistent core learning workflow.
ex_cn: 两个平台必须保持一致的核心学习流程。
tip: 词根：con(共同)+sist(站立)+ent → 始终站在同一立场上 → 始终如一的，一致的

cn: adj. 显眼的，引人注目的，明显的
en: standing out so as to be clearly visible; attracting notice or attention
ex_en: Errors in spelling were conspicuous on the printed summary sheet.
ex_cn: 打印出来的汇总表上，拼写错误格外显眼。
tip: 词根：con(加强)+spic(看)+uous → 一眼就能看到的 → 显眼的，引人注目的

cn: adj. 持续不断的；恒定的，不变的；n. 常数，常量
en: occurring continuously over a period of time; remaining the same
ex_en: Offline software does not require a constant network connection to function.
ex_cn: 离线软件不需要持续不断的网络连接即可正常运行。
tip: 词根：con(加强)+stant(站立) → 站在那里纹丝不动 → 恒定的，持续的

cn: v. 构成，组成；被视为，算作；设立
en: to be a part of a whole; to combine to form something
ex_en: Twelve months constitute a calendar year.
ex_cn: 十二个月构成一个日历年。
tip: 词根：con(共同)+stitut(建立/放置)+e → 放在一起建立起来 → 构成，组成

cn: v. 限制，约束；强迫，迫使
en: to severely restrict the scope, extent, or activity of; to compel or force
ex_en: Hardware memory limits may constrain the size of in-memory caches.
ex_cn: 硬件内存上限可能会限制内存缓存的大小。
tip: 词根：con(共同)+strain(拉紧) → 把绳子拉紧捆住 → 限制，约束

cn: v. 消耗，耗费；吃，喝；使着迷，充满
en: to use up a resource; to eat, drink, or ingest; to completely fill the mind of
ex_en: Lightweight native applications consume far less memory than heavy frameworks.
ex_cn: 轻量级原生应用程序比臃肿的框架消耗少得多的内存。
tip: 词根：con(全部)+sum(拿)+e → 全部拿光用掉 → 消耗，耗费

cn: adj. 当代的，现代的；同时代的；n. 同代人，同龄人
en: living or occurring at the same time; belonging to or occurring in the present
ex_en: Voca blends contemporary minimalist typography with proven memory science.
ex_cn: Voca将当代极简主义排版与经过验证的记忆科学融为一体。
tip: 词根：con(共同)+tempor(时间)+ary → 处于同一时代的 → 同时代的；当代的

cn: v. 声称，主张；竞争，争夺；处理，对付（困难）
en: to assert something as a position in an argument; to struggle to surmount a difficulty
ex_en: Some linguists contend that context is the single best aid for vocabulary acquisition.
ex_cn: 一些语言学家主张，语境是词汇习得最好的辅助手段。
tip: 考研高频词：contend that...（主张/认为…）；contend with...（对付/抗衡…）

cn: n. 上下文，语境；背景，环境，来龙去脉
en: the circumstances that form the setting for an event, statement, or idea
ex_en: Guessing a word's meaning from context strengthens deep semantic memory.
ex_cn: 根据上下文猜测词义能够强化深层语义记忆。
tip: 词根：con(共同)+text(编织) → 编织在一起的前后文 → 语境，背景

cn: v. 反驳，否定；与…相矛盾，与…抵触
en: to deny the truth of a statement by asserting the opposite; to be in conflict with
ex_en: The witness's second statement did not contradict the physical evidence.
ex_cn: 证人的第二份陈述与物证并不矛盾。
tip: 词根：contra(反)+dict(说) → 反着说 → 反驳，相矛盾

cn: v. 捐献，贡献；促成，有助于；撰稿，投稿
en: to give something in order to help achieve or provide something; to help to cause
ex_en: Daily phonetic practice will contribute significantly to your listening comprehension.
ex_cn: 每日的音标与发音练习将极大地促进你的听力理解能力。
tip: 词根：con(共同)+tribut(给予)+e → 大家一起出钱出力 → 贡献，有助于

cn: n. 争论，争议，论战
en: prolonged public disagreement or heated discussion
ex_en: The new policy sparked a heated controversy among education specialists.
ex_cn: 这项新政策在教育专家中引发了激烈的争议。
tip: 词根：contro(反)+vers(转)+y → 观点反着转 → 争议，论战

cn: v. 召集，传唤；集合，开会
en: to come or bring together for a meeting or activity; to assemble
ex_en: The committee will convene next Monday to finalize the syllabus update.
ex_cn: 委员会将于下周一开会，敲定大纲更新内容。
tip: 词根：con(共同)+ven(来)+e → 大家来到一起 → 召集，开会

cn: v. 汇集，聚集；趋同，收敛
en: to tend to meet at a point; to approach an intersection or common state
ex_en: Desktop and mobile user experiences converge around a unified learning engine.
ex_cn: 桌面端和移动端的用户体验围绕统一的学习引擎交汇融合。
tip: 词根：con(共同)+verg(倾斜/转向)+e → 朝同一个点汇拢 → 汇集，收敛（反义：diverge 分歧）

cn: v. 表达，传递（思想或感情）；运送，输送
en: to make an idea, impression, or feeling known or understandable to someone; to transport
ex_en: Colors and typography help convey a calm, focused atmosphere.
ex_cn: 色彩和排版有助于传递一种平静、专注的氛围。
tip: 词根：con(共同)+vey(道路/走) → 通过道路送过去 → 运送；传递（思想）

cn: v. 使确信，使信服；说服，劝说
en: to cause someone to believe firmly in the truth of something; to persuade
ex_en: Empirical test results convinced the team to adopt the offline SQLite architecture.
ex_cn: 实证测试结果使团队信服并采用了离线SQLite架构。
tip: 词根：con(彻底)+vinc(征服)+e → 彻底以理服人 → 使信服，说服

cn: v. 合作，协作；配合
en: to work jointly toward the same end; to assist someone or comply with their requests
ex_en: Hardware and software layers cooperate seamlessly to reduce latency.
ex_cn: 硬件层与软件层无缝协作以降低延迟。
tip: 词根：co(共同)+oper(工作)+ate → 一起工作 → 合作，协作

cn: v. 协调，统筹；n. 坐标；adj. 同等的，并列的
en: to bring the different elements of a complex activity or organization into a harmonious relationship
ex_en: The scheduler coordinates new word learning with five Ebbinghaus review stages.
ex_cn: 调度器将新词学习与五个艾宾浩斯复习阶段统筹协调起来。
tip: 词根：co(共同)+ordin(秩序/排列)+ate → 排成共同的秩序 → 协调；坐标

cn: v. 相一致，符合；相当于；通信
en: to have a close similarity; to match or agree almost exactly; to communicate by exchanging letters
ex_en: The test conclusions must correspond strictly to actual verification results.
ex_cn: 测试结论必须与实际验证结果严格一致。
tip: 词根：cor(共同)+respond(回应) → 彼此呼应 → 相符，一致；通信

cn: n. [pl.] 标准，准则，原则（单数 criterion）
en: principles or standards by which something may be judged or decided
ex_en: Data integrity and offline availability are our primary evaluation criteria.
ex_cn: 数据完整性与离线可用性是我们的首要评估准则。
tip: 词根：crit(判断)+eria → 用于衡量判断的依据 → 准则，标准（注意其为复数形式）

cn: adj. 至关重要的，决定性的，关键的
en: decisive or critical, especially in the success or failure of something
ex_en: Timely review within 24 hours is crucial for consolidating short-term memory.
ex_cn: 24小时内的及时复习对于巩固短期记忆至关重要。
tip: 词根：cruc(十字路口)+ial → 处在人生十字路口的 → 关键的，决定性的

cn: v. 培养，陶冶；耕作，栽培；结交
en: to try to acquire or develop a quality, sentiment, or skill; to prepare and use land for crops
ex_en: Reading English definitions helps cultivate an authentic sense of the language.
ex_cn: 阅读英文释义有助于培养地道的语感。
tip: 词根：cult(耕种/培养)+iv+ate → 像耕耘土地一样培育心智 → 培养，耕作

cn: adj. 累积的，渐增的
en: increasing or increased in quantity, degree, or force by successive additions
ex_en: The cumulative effect of learning thirty words a day is ten thousand words a year.
ex_cn: 每天学三十个单词的累积效应是一年掌握一万词。
tip: 词根：cumul(堆积)+ative → 越堆越多的 → 累积的

cn: v. 控制，抑制，约束；n. 路缘，马勒
en: to restrain or keep in check; a check or restraint on something
ex_en: Structured review schedules help curb the natural rate of forgetting.
ex_cn: 结构化的复习计划有助于遏制自然的遗忘速度。
tip: 考研高频词：原指勒马的嚼子，引申为“抑制、控制、遏制”

cn: v./n. 下降，减少，衰退；v. 婉言拒绝
en: to become smaller, fewer, or less; to politely refuse an invitation or offer
ex_en: Without periodic reinforcement, memory retention will inevitably decline.
ex_cn: 如果没有周期性的强化，记忆留存率不可避免地会下降。
tip: 词根：de(向下)+clin(倾斜)+e → 向下倾斜 → 下降，衰退；婉拒

cn: v. 把…奉献给；致力于，专注于
en: to devote time, effort, or oneself to a particular task or purpose
ex_en: She decided to dedicate thirty minutes every morning to vocabulary review.
ex_cn: 她决定每天早晨专门花三十分钟复习词汇。
tip: 词根：de(加强)+dic(说/宣告)+ate → 庄重宣告将一生献给事业 → 致力于，奉献

cn: v. 推论，推断，演绎
en: to arrive at a fact or a conclusion by reasoning; to draw as a logical conclusion
ex_en: From the root and prefix, you can often deduce the general meaning of an unfamiliar word.
ex_cn: 从词根和前缀中，你通常可以推断出陌生单词的大致含义。
tip: 词根：de(向下)+duc(引导)+e → 顺着逻辑向下推导 → 演绎，推断

cn: n. 缺乏，不足；缺陷，缺点
en: a lack or shortage; a failing or shortcoming
ex_en: Vocabulary deficiency is often the primary bottleneck in reading comprehension.
ex_cn: 词汇量匮乏往往是阅读理解中的首要瓶颈。
tip: 词根：de(向下/不够)+fic(做)+iency → 做得不够 → 缺乏，不足

cn: adj. 故意的，蓄意的；深思熟虑的；v. 仔细考虑，商议
en: done consciously and intentionally; careful and unhurried
ex_en: Deliberate practice focuses specifically on the words you frequently miss.
ex_cn: 刻意练习专门针对你经常记错的那些重难点词汇。
tip: 考研高频熟词：作形容词为“故意的；深思熟虑的”，作动词为“仔细商讨”

cn: v. 证明，证实；演示，展示；游行示威
en: to clearly show the existence or truth of something by giving proof or evidence
ex_en: Ebbinghaus's classic experiments demonstrate how rapidly initial forgetting occurs.
ex_cn: 艾宾浩斯的经典实验证明了最初阶段的遗忘发生得有多快。
tip: 词根：de(加强)+monstr(展示)+ate → 清楚地展示出来 → 证明，演示

cn: v. 表示，意味着；作为…的符号
en: to be a sign of; to indicate; to stand as a name or symbol for
ex_en: In phonetic transcriptions, the stress mark denotes which syllable receives primary emphasis.
ex_cn: 在音标中，重音符号表示哪个音节需要重读。
tip: 词根：de(加强)+not(标记)+e → 用记号标明 → 表示，意味着

cn: v. 描绘，描画；描写，描述
en: to show or represent by a drawing, painting, or other art form; to portray in words
ex_en: The progress chart clearly depicts your daily vocabulary growth curve.
ex_cn: 进度图表清晰地描绘出你每日的词汇增长曲线。
tip: 词根：de(加强)+pict(画) → 生动地画出来 → 描绘，描述

cn: v. 耗尽，用尽，使衰竭
en: to use up the supply or resources of; to diminish in number or quantity
ex_en: Studying for five hours without a break will quickly deplete your mental energy.
ex_cn: 连续学习五小时不休息会迅速耗尽你的脑力精力。
tip: 词根：de(去掉)+plet(满)+e → 从满的状态抽空 → 耗尽，用尽

cn: v. 源于，来自；从…中获得；推导
en: to obtain something from a specified source; to base a concept on a logical extension
ex_en: Many English academic words derive from Latin and classical Greek roots.
ex_cn: 许多英语学术词汇源于拉丁语和古典希腊语词根。
tip: 词根：de(向下)+riv(河流)+e → 顺着源流往下流淌 → 源于，导出

cn: v. 侦查，探测，察觉，发现
en: to discover or identify the presence or existence of something
ex_en: The import module automatically detects UTF-8 and GBK file encodings.
ex_cn: 导入模块会自动检测 UTF-8 和 GBK 文件编码。
tip: 词根：de(去掉)+tect(盖子) → 揭开盖子发现真相 → 探测，察觉

cn: v. 恶化，变坏，退化
en: to become progressively worse
ex_en: Language proficiency can deteriorate rapidly if you stop reading and practicing.
ex_cn: 如果停止阅读和练习，语言能力可能会迅速退化。
tip: 词根：deterior(更坏)+ate → 变得越来越糟 → 恶化，退化

cn: v. 决定，确定；查明，测定；下定决心
en: to cause something to occur in a particular way; to ascertain or establish exactly
ex_en: Your daily consistency will determine how quickly you master the entire lexicon.
ex_cn: 你每天的坚持将决定你多快能掌握整个词库。
tip: 词根：de(加强)+termin(界限)+e → 划定明确的界限 → 确定，决定

cn: v. 偏离，背离，违背
en: to depart from an established course or standard
ex_en: Do not deviate from your Ebbinghaus review plan during the critical first week.
ex_cn: 在关键的第一周内，不要偏离你的艾宾浩斯复习计划。
tip: 词根：de(偏离)+vi(道路)+ate → 走离正轨 → 偏离，背离

cn: v. 设计，发明，想出（计划或方法）
en: to plan or invent a complex procedure, system, or mechanism by careful thought
ex_en: Hermann Ebbinghaus devised a scientific method to measure memory decay.
ex_cn: 赫尔曼·艾宾浩斯设计了一种测量记忆衰退的科学方法。
tip: 助记：与名牌设备 device 同源，作动词意为“精心设计、想出”

cn: v. 区分，区别；使不同，产生差异
en: to recognize or ascertain what makes someone or something different
ex_en: Good learners differentiate between active writing vocabulary and passive reading words.
ex_cn: 优秀的学习者会区分主动写作词汇与被动阅读词汇。
tip: 词根：different(不同的)+iate → 分辨出不同之处 → 区分，区别

cn: v. 传播，散布；扩散，弥漫；adj. 弥漫的，冗长的
en: to spread or cause to spread over a wide area or among a large number of people
ex_en: Printed books helped diffuse scientific knowledge across continents.
ex_cn: 印刷书籍帮助科学知识跨越大陆广泛传播。
tip: 词根：dif(分开)+fus(流/倾倒)+e → 四散流开 → 扩散，传播

cn: n. 进退两难的境地，左右为难，困境
en: a situation in which a difficult choice has to be made between two or more alternatives
ex_en: Engineers often face a dilemma between feature richness and interface simplicity.
ex_cn: 工程师经常在功能丰富度与界面简洁性之间面临两难抉择。
tip: 词根：di(二)+lemma(前提/争论) → 两个前提都难选 → 进退两难

cn: v. 减少，减小，削弱；贬低
en: to make or become less; to cause to seem less impressive or valuable
ex_en: As you move mastered words out of the list, your review workload will steadily diminish.
ex_cn: 随着你将熟词移出列表，你的复习负担会稳步减轻。
tip: 词根：di(加强)+min(小)+ish → 使变得越来越小 → 减少，削弱

cn: v. 看出，察觉出；辨别，明辨
en: to perceive or recognize something; to distinguish someone or something with difficulty
ex_en: With practice, you can discern subtle differences in usage between near-synonyms.
ex_cn: 通过练习，你可以辨别近义词之间在用法上的微妙差异。
tip: 词根：dis(分开)+cern(筛分/搞清) → 把混在一起的东西分辨清 → 明辨，察觉

cn: n. 差异，不一致，出入，矛盾
en: a lack of compatibility or similarity between two or more facts
ex_en: The audit revealed a discrepancy between the expected and actual record counts.
ex_cn: 审查发现预期记录数与实际记录数之间存在出入。
tip: 词根：dis(不一致)+crep(发出杂音)+ancy → 声音不和谐 → 差异，矛盾

cn: adj. 离散的，不连续的，互不相连的
en: individually separate and distinct
ex_en: Breaking a massive lexicon into fifteen discrete lists makes learning manageable.
ex_cn: 将庞大的词库拆分为十五个独立的词表能让学习变得易于管理。
tip: 注意区分：discrete（离散的，e被t分开）vs discreet（言行谨慎的，ee紧挨在一起）

cn: v. 区分，辨别；歧视，区别对待
en: to recognize a distinction; to make an unjust or prejudicial distinction
ex_en: Phonetic training helps your ear discriminate between similar vowel sounds.
ex_cn: 语音训练有助于你的耳朵辨别相似的元音发音。
tip: 词根：dis(分开)+crimin(分辨/审理)+ate → 区分开来；区别对待

cn: v. 取代，替代；迫使…离开家园；置换
en: to take over the place, position, or role of someone or something
ex_en: Digital flashcard systems have largely displaced bulky paper index cards.
ex_cn: 数字化单词卡系统在很大程度上取代了笨重的纸质索引卡片。
tip: 词根：dis(移开)+place(位置) → 移走原物占其位置 → 取代，置换

cn: v. 排列，布置；使倾向于；处理，丢弃（dispose of）
en: to get rid of by throwing away or giving or selling to someone else; to incline someone toward
ex_en: Once a word is permanently memorized, you can dispose of it from your active queue.
ex_cn: 一旦某个单词被永久记住，你就可以将其从当前学习队列中移除。
tip: 词根：dis(分开)+pos(放置)+e → 分别安排妥当 → 处置，倾向于

cn: v. 扰乱，打乱，中断
en: to interrupt an event, activity, or process by causing a disturbance or problem
ex_en: Pop-up advertisements disrupt concentration, which is why Voca is completely ad-free.
ex_cn: 弹窗广告会打乱注意力，因此 Voca 完全不含任何广告。
tip: 词根：dis(四散)+rupt(断裂) → 使原本连续的过程断开 → 扰乱，中断

cn: v. （使）消散，散去；挥霍，浪费（时间或精力）
en: to disappear or cause to disappear; to squander or fritter away
ex_en: Initial exam anxiety quickly dissipates once you follow a clear daily study plan.
ex_cn: 一旦你遵循清晰的每日学习计划，最初的考试焦虑很快就会消散。
tip: 词根：dis(四散)+sip(投掷)+ate → 四处挥洒殆尽 → 消散；挥霍

cn: adj. 截然不同的，有区别的；清晰的，明显的
en: recognizably different in nature from something else of a similar type; readily perceived
ex_en: Voca offers four distinct visual themes tailored for daytime and nighttime reading.
ex_cn: Voca 提供四种截然不同的视觉主题，专为日间和夜间阅读量身定制。
tip: 词根：di(分开)+stinct(刺/标志) → 做好不同标记区分开的 → 截然不同的，清晰的

cn: v. 扭曲，曲解，歪曲；使变形，失真
en: to pull or twist out of shape; to give a misleading or false account of
ex_en: Never distort or fabricate test results when evaluating software stability.
ex_cn: 评估软件稳定性时，绝不能歪曲或伪造测试结果。
tip: 词根：dis(偏离)+tort(扭曲) → 拧歪了 → 扭曲，歪曲

cn: v. 分配，分发；使分布，散布；分销
en: to give shares of something; to deal out; to spread throughout a space or area
ex_en: In shuffle mode, the algorithm distributes high-frequency words evenly across all lists.
ex_cn: 在乱序模式下，算法将高频词均匀分配到各个词表中。
tip: 词根：dis(分开)+tribut(给予)+e → 分发给每个人 → 分配，分布

cn: adj. 多种多样的，形形色色的，不同的
en: showing a great deal of variety; very different
ex_en: Our learners have diverse goals ranging from graduate entrance exams to academic reading.
ex_cn: 我们的学习者有着从考研到学术阅读等多种多样的学习目标。
tip: 词根：di(分开)+vers(转)+e → 朝不同方向转 → 多样的，不同的

cn: v. 使转向，使改道；转移（注意力或资金）；使消遣
en: to cause someone or something to change course or turn from one direction to another
ex_en: Minimalist design ensures that decorative elements never divert your attention from the word.
ex_cn: 极简设计确保装饰元素绝不会分散你对单词本身的注意力。
tip: 词根：di(偏离)+vert(转) → 转到别的路上 → 使转向，转移注意力

cn: adj. 占主导地位的，占优势的；显性的
en: most important, powerful, or influential
ex_en: Spaced repetition remains the dominant paradigm in evidence-based memory software.
ex_cn: 间隔重复仍然是循证记忆软件中占主导地位的范式。
tip: 词根：domin(统治/主人)+ant → 处于统治地位的 → 占主导地位的

cn: adj. 激烈的，猛烈的，大刀阔斧的，极端的
en: likely to have a strong or far-reaching effect; radical and extreme
ex_en: Removing mastered words brings a drastic reduction in daily review time.
ex_cn: 剔除已掌握的熟词能大幅缩减每日的复习耗时。
tip: 助记：drast(做/行动)+ic → 采取雷厉风行行动的 → 大刀阔斧的，猛烈的

cn: adj. 耐用的，持久的，长久的
en: able to withstand wear, pressure, or damage; hard-wearing and long-lasting
ex_en: Combining visual cards, audio dictation, and active spelling creates durable memory traces.
ex_cn: 将视觉卡片、听写和主动拼写相结合能形成持久的记忆痕迹。
tip: 词根：dur(持续/坚硬)+able → 能够长久持续的 → 耐用的，持久的

cn: adj. 动态的；充满活力的；n. 动力，相互作用力
en: characterized by constant change, activity, or progress; energetic
ex_en: The dynamic schedule adjusts automatically whenever you reset or customize your list count.
ex_cn: 每当你重置或自定义 List 数量时，动态计划表都会自动调整。
tip: 词根：dynam(力量/动力)+ic → 有内在驱动力的 → 动态的，充满活力的

cn: adj. 精心制作的，详尽的，复杂的；v. 详细阐述，详尽说明
en: involving many carefully arranged parts or details; to develop or present in detail
ex_en: Tap the dictionary button to elaborate on a word's etymology and collocations.
ex_cn: 点击词典按钮可详细展开单词的词源与搭配用法。
tip: 词根：e(出)+labor(劳动)+ate → 花费大量心血做出来的 → 精巧详尽的；详细阐述

cn: v. 提升，提高，抬高；振奋（情绪）
en: to raise or lift something to a higher position; to raise to a more important or impressive level
ex_en: Mastering core academic vocabulary will noticeably elevate your writing score.
ex_cn: 掌握核心学术词汇将显著提高你的写作得分。
tip: 词根：e(出)+lev(轻/举起)+ate → 向上举起 → 提升，提高

cn: v. 引出，诱出，探出（事实或反应）
en: to evoke or draw out a reaction, answer, or fact from someone
ex_en: Hiding the Chinese translation is designed to elicit active recall from your memory.
ex_cn: 隐藏中文释义旨在诱发你大脑的主动回忆。
tip: 注意区分：elicit（引出、诱出，动词）vs illicit（非法的，形容词）

cn: v. 消除，排除，淘汰，根除
en: to completely remove or get rid of something
ex_en: Swipe left on any word you already know well to eliminate it from future study rounds.
ex_cn: 对任何你已经烂熟于心的单词向左滑动，即可将其从后续学习轮次中剔除。
tip: 词根：e(出)+limin(门槛)+ate → 赶出门槛之外 → 淘汰，消除

cn: adj. 难以捉摸的，难懂的，易忘的，难以找到的
en: difficult to find, catch, or achieve; difficult to remember or recall
ex_en: The exact nuance of an elusive word becomes clear when seen in a vivid sentence.
ex_cn: 一个难以捉摸的词汇的微妙含义，在生动的例句中会变得清晰明了。
tip: 词根：e(出)+lus(玩耍/溜走)+ive → 泥鳅一样溜走的 → 难以捉摸的，易忘的

cn: v. 解放，使摆脱束缚，使获得自由
en: to set free, especially from legal, social, or political restrictions
ex_en: Offline capability emancipates learners from reliance on unstable network connections.
ex_cn: 离线能力将学习者从对不稳定网络连接的依赖中解放出来。
tip: 词根：e(出)+man(手)+cip(抓)+ate → 从紧抓的手中放出来 → 解放

cn: v. 体现，具体表现；包含，收录
en: to be an expression of or give a tangible or visible form to an idea, quality, or feeling
ex_en: Voca's interface is crafted to embody clarity, focus, and effortless efficiency.
ex_cn: Voca的界面设计旨在体现清晰、专注与流畅高效。
tip: 词根：em(使…)+body(身体/实体) → 赋予具体形体 → 体现，包含

cn: v./n. 拥抱；欣然接受，采纳；包含
en: to hold closely in one's arms; to accept or support willingly and enthusiastically
ex_en: Successful learners embrace mistakes during spelling tests as opportunities to strengthen memory.
ex_cn: 成功的学习者欣然接受拼写测试中的错误，将其视为强化记忆的契机。
tip: 词根：em(进入)+brace(双臂) → 揽入双臂之中 → 拥抱；欣然接受

cn: v. 浮现，出现；显露，为人所知；摆脱出来
en: to move out of or away from something and come into view; to become apparent
ex_en: Clear patterns of progress emerge after just seven days of Ebbinghaus review.
ex_cn: 仅仅经过七天的艾宾浩斯复习，清晰的进步轨迹就会显现出来。
tip: 词根：e(出)+merg(沉没)+e → 从水中浮出水面 → 浮现，出现

cn: adj. 实证的，以经验或实验为依据的
en: based on, concerned with, or verifiable by observation or experience rather than theory or pure logic
ex_en: Every conclusion in our technical report is grounded in empirical verification.
ex_cn: 我们技术报告中的每一项结论都建立在实证验证的基础之上。
tip: 考研核心学术词：常与 theoretical（理论上的）对比出现，意为“实证的、实验验证的”

cn: v. 效仿，模仿并赶超；仿真，模拟
en: to match or surpass a person or achievement, typically by imitation
ex_en: While drawing inspiration from classic apps, Voca does not merely emulate them.
ex_cn: 在汲取经典应用灵感的同时，Voca 并非简单地模仿它们。
tip: 词根：emul(竞争/赶超)+ate → 在学习借鉴中力求超越 → 效仿，仿真

cn: v. 包含，涵盖，包括；包围，环绕
en: to surround and have or hold within; to include comprehensively
ex_en: The built-in lexicons encompass CET-4, CET-6, Postgraduate, and Academic English.
ex_cn: 内置词库涵盖了四级、六级、考研和学术英语词汇。
tip: 词根：en(进入)+compass(罗盘/范围) → 纳入罗盘范围之内 → 包含，涵盖

cn: v./n. 努力，尽力，竭力；事业，尝试
en: to try hard to do or achieve something; an attempt to achieve a goal
ex_en: Mastering a foreign language is a rewarding lifelong endeavor.
ex_cn: 掌握一门外语是一项回报丰厚的终身事业。
tip: 助记：en(使)+deavor(职责) → 尽心尽力履行职责 → 努力，事业

cn: v. 赋予，赐予（天生能力或特质）；向…捐钱（设立基金）
en: to provide with a quality, ability, or asset; to give or bequeath an income or property to
ex_en: Human beings are endowed with a remarkable capacity for associative memory.
ex_cn: 人类天生具备非凡的联想记忆能力。
tip: 常考搭配：be endowed with...（天生具有…，被赋予…）

cn: v. 忍受，忍耐；持久，持续存在
en: to suffer something painful or difficult patiently; to remain in existence; to last
ex_en: Knowledge acquired through spaced active recall will endure for years.
ex_cn: 通过间隔主动回忆获得的知识将持久保留多年。
tip: 词根：en(使)+dur(持久/坚硬)+e → 经受住考验持续下去 → 忍耐；持久

cn: v. 提高，增强，增进（价值、质量或吸引力）
en: to intensify, increase, or further improve the quality, value, or extent of
ex_en: Bilingual example sentences and audio pronunciation greatly enhance memory retention.
ex_cn: 双语例句与语音朗读极大地增强了记忆留存率。
tip: 词根：en(使)+hanc(高)+e → 使推向更高水平 → 提高，增强

cn: n. 启迪，启发，开导；启蒙运动
en: the action of enlightening or the state of being enlightened; spiritual or intellectual awakening
ex_en: Reading philosophical classics brings intellectual enlightenment and critical perspective.
ex_cn: 阅读哲学经典能带来智识上的启迪与批判性视角。
tip: 词根：en(使)+light(光)+en+ment → 照亮心灵驱散蒙昧 → 启迪，启蒙

cn: v. 牵涉，需要，使成为必要；蕴含
en: to involve something as a necessary or inevitable part or consequence
ex_en: Building reliable dual-platform software entails rigorous testing and data validation.
ex_cn: 开发可靠的双平台软件需要严格的测试与数据验证。
tip: 考研高频词：A entails B 意为“A必然伴随/需要B”

cn: n. 实体，独立存在物；组织，机构
en: a thing with distinct and independent existence
ex_en: In database design, each vocabulary word is modeled as an independent entity.
ex_cn: 在数据库设计中，每个词汇都被建模为一个独立的实体。
tip: 词根：ent(存在)+ity → 客观实在之物 → 实体

cn: v. 列举，枚举，逐一清点
en: to mention a number of things one by one
ex_en: The documentation enumerates all supported import file formats and keyboard shortcuts.
ex_cn: 文档逐一列举了所有受支持的导入文件格式和键盘快捷键。
tip: 词根：e(出)+numer(数字)+ate → 按数字一个个点出来 → 列举，枚举

cn: v. 设想，展望，想象（未来蓝图）
en: to imagine as a future possibility; to visualize
ex_en: We envision Voca as a lifelong companion for independent language learners.
ex_cn: 我们将 Voca 设想为自主语言学习者的终身伴侣。
tip: 词根：en(进入)+vision(视界/愿景) → 在脑海中描绘愿景 → 展望，设想

cn: adj. 短暂的，转瞬即逝的，朝生暮死的
en: lasting for a very short time
ex_en: Without Ebbinghaus review, cramming before an exam produces only ephemeral memory.
ex_cn: 如果没有艾宾浩斯式的复习，考前突击只能产生转瞬即逝的短暂记忆。
tip: 词根：epi(在…期间)+hemer(一天)+al → 只活一天的 → 转瞬即逝的

cn: n. 平衡，均衡；心理平静
en: a state in which opposing forces or influences are balanced
ex_en: An effective study plan maintains an equilibrium between new words and review tasks.
ex_cn: 高效的学习计划在新学词汇与复习任务之间保持均衡。
tip: 词根：equi(相等)+libr(天平/重量)+ium → 天平两端重量相等 → 平衡，均衡

cn: adj. 相等的，等价的，等效的；n. 对等物，对应词
en: equal in value, amount, function, meaning, etc.
ex_en: Not every English word has a single exact one-to-one equivalent in Chinese.
ex_cn: 并非每个英语单词在汉语中都有唯一完全对应的词。
tip: 词根：equi(相等)+val(价值)+ent → 价值完全相等的 → 等价的；对应词

cn: v. 根除，根绝，彻底消灭
en: to destroy completely; to put an end to
ex_en: Repeated spelling challenges help eradicate stubborn spelling mistakes.
ex_cn: 反复的拼写挑战有助于根除顽固的拼写错误。
tip: 词根：e(出)+radic(根)+ate → 连根拔起 → 根除，杜绝

cn: adj. 错误的，不正确的
en: wrong; incorrect; based on mistaken belief
ex_en: The system immediately highlights erroneous letters in red during spelling mode.
ex_cn: 在拼词模式中，系统会立即用红色高亮显示错误的字母。
tip: 词根：err(错误)+oneous → 犯错的 → 错误的，不正确的

cn: v. （使）逐步升级，（使）加剧，不断恶化
en: to increase rapidly; to become or cause to become more intense or serious
ex_en: If you skip three days of review, your backlog of unreviewed lists will quickly escalate.
ex_cn: 如果你跳过三天的复习，积压的未复习词表就会迅速增加。
tip: 助记：来自 escalator（自动扶梯）→ 像坐扶梯一样层层升高 → 升级，加剧

cn: adj. 必不可少的，极其重要的；本质的；n. 要素，必需品
en: absolutely necessary; extremely important; fundamental
ex_en: Local data persistence is essential for a truly offline vocabulary application.
ex_cn: 本地数据持久化对于真正离线的背单词应用来说是必不可少的。
tip: 词根：ess(存在/本质)+ent+ial → 构成事物本质的 → 本质的，必不可少的

cn: v. 建立，创立；确立，证实
en: to set up on a firm or permanent basis; to show something to be true or certain
ex_en: First, establish a realistic daily target that fits your schedule.
ex_cn: 首先，确立一个切合你日程安排的每日目标。
tip: 词根：e+stabl(稳定)+ish → 使稳固地立起来 → 建立，证实

cn: v. 评估，评价；求…的值
en: to form an idea of the amount, number, or value of; to assess
ex_en: Self-testing in single-language mode lets you honestly evaluate your familiarity.
ex_cn: 在单语模式下自测能让你诚实地评估自己对单词的熟悉程度。
tip: 词根：e(出)+valu(价值)+ate → 评定出某物的价值 → 评估，评价

cn: v. 唤起，引起，勾起（记忆、感情或图像）
en: to bring or recall a feeling, memory, or image to the conscious mind
ex_en: Hearing a word pronounced in a natural sentence helps evoke its meaning instantly.
ex_cn: 在自然例句中听到单词发音有助于瞬间唤起它的词义。
tip: 词根：e(出)+vok(喊/呼唤)+e → 把内心深处的记忆呼唤出来 → 唤起，勾起

cn: v. 使恶化，使加重，使加剧
en: to make a problem, bad situation, or negative feeling worse
ex_en: Rote memorization without context only exacerbates learner boredom and fatigue.
ex_cn: 脱离语境的死记硬背只会加剧学习者的枯燥与疲惫感。
tip: 词根：ex(加强)+acerb(酸苦/尖刻)+ate → 使情况变得更苦涩 → 使恶化，加剧

cn: v. 夸大，夸张，言过其实
en: to represent something as being larger, better, or worse than it really is
ex_en: It is impossible to exaggerate the importance of vocabulary in academic reading.
ex_cn: 在学术阅读中，词汇的重要性无论怎样强调都不为过。
tip: 词根：ex(出)+agger(堆积)+ate → 堆得高出实际 → 夸大，夸张

cn: v. 超过，超出；超越（限制或权限）
en: to be greater in number or size than a quantity, number, or other measurable thing
ex_en: When a single file exceeds the 10 MB transfer limit, alternative local synthesis is required.
ex_cn: 当单个文件超出10MB传输上限时，需要采用替代的本地构建方案。
tip: 词根：ex(出)+ceed(走) → 走出界限之外 → 超过，超出

cn: n. 例外，除外；异议
en: a person or thing that is excluded from a general statement or does not follow a rule
ex_en: Every rule in English grammar seems to have at least one interesting exception.
ex_cn: 英语语法中的每一条规则似乎都至少有一个有趣的例外。
tip: 词根：ex(出)+cept(拿)+ion → 单独拿出来不按常理算的 → 例外

cn: v. 是…的典范（或典型）；举例说明
en: to be a typical example of; to give an example of; to illustrate by giving examples
ex_en: Well-chosen sentences exemplify how a word functions in real communication.
ex_cn: 精选的例句能够举例说明单词在真实交流中是如何运用的。
tip: 词根：exempl(榜样/例子)+ify(使…) → 用例子加以说明；成为典范

cn: v. 使筋疲力尽；耗尽，用光；详尽探讨；n. 废气
en: to drain of strength or energy; to use up completely; to explore a subject thoroughly
ex_en: Short, focused 15-minute study sessions prevent you from exhausting your attention span.
ex_cn: 简短专注的15分钟学习单元能防止你耗尽注意力。
tip: 考研熟词僻义：exhaust all possibilities 意为“穷尽/详尽探讨所有可能性”

cn: adj. 明确的，清楚的，直截了当的；详述的
en: stated clearly and in detail, leaving no room for confusion or doubt
ex_en: Our test report makes an explicit distinction between verified facts and inferences.
ex_cn: 我们的测试报告在已验证事实与合理推断之间做出了明确的区分。
tip: 词根：ex(出)+plic(折叠)+it → 把折叠的东西完全展开 → 明确的（反义：implicit 隐含的）

cn: v. 开发，利用，发挥；剥削；n. 英勇事迹，功绩
en: to make full use of and derive benefit from a resource; to use unfairly
ex_en: Voca exploits the spacing effect of human memory to maximize learning efficiency.
ex_cn: Voca 充分利用人类记忆的间隔效应，将学习效率最大化。
tip: 考研高频词：中性义为“开发、充分利用（资源/机制）”，贬义为“剥削”

cn: v. 促进，推动，使便利，使容易
en: to make an action or process easy or easier
ex_en: Keyboard shortcuts on Windows facilitate rapid navigation through word lists.
ex_cn: Windows端的键盘快捷键为快速浏览单词列表提供了极大便利。
tip: 词根：facil(容易)+itate → 使事情变得容易 → 促进，使便利

cn: adj. 可行的，行得通的，办得到的
en: possible to do easily or conveniently; likely or probable
ex_en: Dividing 3,000 words into 15 manageable lists makes the 30-day goal completely feasible.
ex_cn: 将3000词划分为15个易于管理的词表，使30天攻克目标完全可行。
tip: 词根：feas(做)+ible → 能够做得到的 → 可行的

cn: v. 波动，起伏，涨落，动摇
en: to rise and fall irregularly in number or amount
ex_en: Even when your daily free time fluctuates, you can adjust the list size flexibly.
ex_cn: 即使你每天的空闲时间有所波动，你也可以灵活调整词表大小。
tip: 词根：fluct(波浪/流动)+uate → 像海浪一样上下起伏 → 波动，涨落

cn: v. 制定，规划，构想；确切表达；用公式表示
en: to create or prepare methodically; to express an idea in a concise or systematic way
ex_en: Before writing any code, we formulate a comprehensive architectural plan.
ex_cn: 在编写任何代码之前，我们先制定一份周密的技术架构方案。
tip: 词根：formul(公式/规则)+ate → 形成系统的规则或方案 → 制定，确切表达

cn: v. 培养，促进，助长；养育，代养；adj. 寄养的
en: to encourage or promote the development of something; to bring up a child
ex_en: Immediate visual and audio feedback helps foster a lasting daily study habit.
ex_cn: 即时的视觉和音效反馈有助于培养持久的每日学习习惯。
tip: 助记：与 food（食物）同源 → 给食物喂养长大 → 养育；培养，促进

cn: adj. 基本的，根本的，核心的；n. 基本原理，基础
en: forming a necessary base or core; of central importance
ex_en: Offline independence is a fundamental design requirement of the Voca project.
ex_cn: 离线独立运行是 Voca 项目的一项根本设计要求。
tip: 词根：fund(底部/基础)+ament+al → 作为地基的 → 根本的，基础的

cn: adj. 真正的，名副其实的；真诚的，真心的
en: truly what something is said to be; authentic; sincere
ex_en: Deliverables must be genuine executable packages rather than static mockups.
ex_cn: 交付物必须是真正可运行的程序包，而非静态界面原型。
tip: 词根：genu(出生/血统)+ine → 血统纯正的 → 真正的，真诚的

cn: v. 妨碍，阻碍，牵制；n. 有盖提篮
en: to hinder or impede the movement or progress of
ex_en: Cluttered interfaces and slow startup times hamper learning efficiency.
ex_cn: 杂乱的界面和缓慢的启动速度会妨碍学习效率。
tip: 考研高频词：常与 hinder / impede 同义替换，意为“阻碍、牵制”

cn: v. 控制并利用（自然力或资源）；给（马）套挽具；n. 挽具，安全带
en: to control and make use of natural resources or power to produce energy or achieve a result
ex_en: Voca harnesses the Ebbinghaus forgetting curve to schedule optimal review intervals.
ex_cn: Voca 利用艾宾浩斯遗忘曲线来规划最佳的复习间隔。
tip: 助记：原指给骏马套上马具使其拉车，引申为“驾驭、有效利用（力量/规律）”

cn: n. 等级制度；层次体系，层级结构
en: a system or organization in which people or groups are ranked one above the other
ex_en: Clear typographic hierarchy separates the headword, phonetics, definitions, and examples.
ex_cn: 清晰的排版层级将单词词目、音标、释义和例句分离开来。
tip: 词根：hier(神圣/高级)+arch(统治)+y → 层层管辖的体系 → 层级结构，等级体系

cn: adj. 整体的，全面的，全局的
en: characterized by comprehension of the parts of something as intimately interconnected
ex_en: Combining listening, reading, and spelling provides a holistic approach to word mastery.
ex_cn: 将听音、认读与拼写相结合，提供了一种掌握词汇的整体方法。
tip: 助记：与 whole（整体）同源 → 从全局和整体看待事物的 → 整体的

cn: n. 假说，假设，前提（复数 hypotheses）
en: a supposition or proposed explanation made on the basis of limited evidence as a starting point for further investigation
ex_en: Scientists formulate a testable hypothesis before conducting controlled experiments.
ex_cn: 科学家在进行对照实验之前会提出一个可检验的假说。
tip: 词根：hypo(在…下面)+thesis(放置/论点) → 放在底下作为起点的前提 → 假说，假设

cn: v. 照亮，照明；阐明，启发，使清晰易懂
en: to light up; to help to clarify or explain a subject or matter
ex_en: Etymological notes illuminate the hidden connections between seemingly unrelated words.
ex_cn: 词源注释阐明了看似无关的单词之间隐藏的内在联系。
tip: 词根：il(进入)+lumin(光)+ate → 把光投射进去 → 照亮；阐明，启发

cn: v. 使浸没；使沉浸在，使全神贯注于
en: to dip or submerge in a liquid; to involve oneself deeply in a particular activity
ex_en: Card mode allows you to immerse yourself in one word at a time without distraction.
ex_cn: 卡片模式让你可以毫无干扰地一次沉浸于一个单词的学习中。
tip: 常考搭配：immerse oneself in... / be immersed in...（沉浸于…，全神贯注于…）

cn: adj. 势在必行的，极其重要的，必要的；祈使的；n. 必要的事，当务之急
en: of vital importance; crucial; giving an authoritative command
ex_en: Protecting user data across software updates is an absolute imperative.
ex_cn: 在软件升级过程中保护用户数据完整是绝对的当务之急。
tip: 词根：im+per(命令/帝王)+ative → 如同皇命般必须执行的 → 势在必行的；祈使语气

cn: v. 实施，执行，实现，贯彻；n. 工具，器具
en: to put a decision, plan, agreement, or system into effect; a tool or utensil
ex_en: We implemented a dual-layer persistence engine using LocalStorage and IndexedDB.
ex_cn: 我们使用 LocalStorage 和 IndexedDB 实现了双层持久化存储引擎。
tip: 考研高频词：作动词为“实施、实现”，作名词为“工具、器具”

cn: adj. 含蓄的，隐含的，不言而喻的；绝对的
en: suggested though not directly expressed; always to be found in; essentially connected with
ex_en: Understanding implicit cultural connotations requires reading authentic examples.
ex_cn: 理解隐含的文化内涵需要阅读地道的例句。
tip: 词根：im(进入)+plic(折叠)+it → 折在里面没露出来的 → 隐含的（反义：explicit 明确的）

cn: n. 激励，刺激，诱因，鼓励；adj. 激励的

ex_cn: 五卡片字母点选器为练习单词拼写提供了一种新颖的触控交互方式。

cn: adj. 表达清楚的，清晰易懂的；头脑清醒的

cn: v. 表明，清楚显示，显现；adj. 明显的，显而易见的；n. 载货单

cn: adj. 一丝不苟的，细致入微的，极为谨慎的

ex_en: Bilingual mode provides simultaneous visibility of both the English word and its Chinese meaning.
ex_cn: 双语模式让你能够同时看到英语单词及其汉语释义。
tip: 词根：simul(同时/相似)+taneous → 在同一时刻发生的 → 同时的，同步的

cn: adj. 自发的，不由自主的；自然的，天真率直的
en: performed or occurring as a result of a sudden inner impulse or inclination and without premeditation
ex_en: True fluency means spontaneous comprehension without translating word by word.
ex_cn: 真正的流利意味着自发的理解，而无需逐词翻译。
tip: 词根：spont(自愿/心意)+aneous → 发自本心自然流露的 → 自发的，自然的

cn: adj. 随后的，后来的，接下去的
en: coming after something in time; following
ex_en: Day 1 is for initial memorization, while subsequent days focus on spaced reinforcement.
ex_cn: 第一天用于初次记忆，而随后的几天则侧重于间隔强化。
tip: 词根：sub(在后面)+sequ(跟随)+ent → 紧跟在后面的 → 随后的，后来的

cn: v. 证实，证明，为…提供确凿证据
en: to provide evidence to support or prove the truth of
ex_en: Every claim in the test report must be substantiated by actual execution checks.
ex_cn: 测试报告中的每一项声明都必须有实际的运行检查结果予以证实。
tip: 词根：substant(实质/实体)+iate → 拿出实质证据支撑 → 证实，证明

cn: adj. 微妙的，细微的；敏锐的；巧妙的（注意字母 b 不发音）
en: so delicate or precise as to be difficult to analyze or describe; making use of clever and indirect methods
ex_en: Subtle card animations provide tactile feedback without distracting the learner.
ex_cn: 微妙细腻的卡片动效提供了触感反馈，同时不会分散学习者的注意力。
tip: 发音与拼写重点：字母 b 不发音（/ˈsʌtl/），常考形容词义“微妙的、不易察觉的”

cn: adj. 简明的，简洁的，言简意赅的
en: briefly and clearly expressed
ex_en: Dictionary definitions should be succinct so learners can grasp the core meaning at a glance.
ex_cn: 词典释义应当简明扼要，以便学习者一眼掌握核心词义。
tip: 词根：suc(在下面)+cinct(束紧衣带) → 把长袍扎紧利落 → 简明的，言简意赅的

cn: v. 维持，保持；支撑；遭受，承受
en: to strengthen or support physically or mentally; to cause to continue for an extended period
ex_en: Visual progress rings help sustain learner engagement across the full 30-day cycle.
ex_cn: 可视化的进度环有助于在整个30天周期内持续维持学习者的投入度。
tip: 词根：sus(在下面)+tain(握住/撑住) → 在底下牢牢托住 → 维持，支撑

cn: v. 综合，整合；合成（物质或声音）
en: to combine a number of things into a coherent whole; to produce by chemical or electronic synthesis
ex_en: The audio engine can synthesize clear tones and speech completely offline.
ex_cn: 音频引擎能够在完全离线的状态下合成清晰的提示音与语音。
tip: 词根：syn(共同)+thes(放置)+ize → 放到一起融合成整体 → 综合，合成

cn: adj. 有形的，可触摸的；切实的，明确的
en: perceptible by touch; clear and definite; real
ex_en: Watching your mastered word count climb gives you a tangible sense of achievement.
ex_cn: 看着已掌握的熟词数量不断攀升，会给你带来切实的成就感。
tip: 词根：tang(接触/触摸)+ible → 摸得着的 → 有形的，切实的（反义：intangible 无形的）

cn: adj. 试探性的，暂定的；犹豫不决的
en: not certain or fixed; provisional; done without confidence
ex_en: Inferences without binary confirmation must be labeled as tentative rather than verified facts.
ex_cn: 未经二进制确认的推断必须标明为试探性推断，而非已验证事实。
tip: 词根：tent(尝试/试探)+ative → 试探着来的 → 暂定的，试探性的

cn: n. 门槛，门口；阈限，临界值；开端，起点
en: a strip of wood or stone forming the bottom of a doorway; the magnitude or intensity that must be exceeded for a certain reaction
ex_en: Once a word's unfamiliarity score crosses a threshold, it is prioritized for extra spelling practice.
ex_cn: 一旦单词的“不会程度”超过设定阈值，系统就会优先安排其进行额外的拼写强化。
tip: 助记：thresh(打谷)+hold(保持) → 门口挡住谷粒的木板 → 门槛，临界值

cn: v. 超越，超出（界限或范围），胜过
en: to be or go beyond the range or limits of something abstract; to surpass
ex_en: Good software design transcends platform boundaries while respecting native ergonomics.
ex_cn: 优秀的软件设计在尊重各平台原生操作习惯的同时，超越了平台界限。
tip: 词根：trans(跨越)+scend(攀爬) → 翻越过去 → 超越，胜过

cn: adj. 短暂的，转瞬即逝的，暂住的；n. 暂住者，瞬态
en: lasting only for a short time; impermanent
ex_en: Sensory memory is transient and fades within seconds unless transferred to long-term storage.
ex_cn: 感觉记忆是短暂的，除非转化为长期存储，否则在几秒钟内就会消退。
tip: 词根：trans(越过)+i(走)+ent → 匆匆走过不停留的 → 短暂的，转瞬即逝的

cn: adj. 透明的；公开透明的；显而易见的，易懂的
en: allowing light to pass through so that objects behind can be distinctly seen; open to public scrutiny
ex_en: Our documentation provides a transparent account of all data sources and licenses.
ex_cn: 我们的文档对所有数据来源及开源授权依据提供了公开透明的说明。
tip: 词根：trans(穿过)+par(显现)+ent → 光线能穿透显现的 → 透明的，坦率的

cn: adj. 无处不在的，普遍存在的，随处可见的
en: present, appearing, or found everywhere
ex_en: Smartphones and laptops have made digital learning tools ubiquitous in modern education.
ex_cn: 智能手机和笔记本电脑使数字化学习工具在现代教育中无处不在。
tip: 词根：ubi(何处/处处)+quit+ous → 到处都有的 → 无处不在的

cn: v. 逐渐削弱，暗中损害，动摇（根基或权威）
en: to erode the base or foundation of; to lessen the effectiveness, power, or ability of, especially gradually or insidiously
ex_en: Inconsistent study habits will gradually undermine your confidence before the exam.
ex_cn: 三天打鱼两天晒网的学习习惯会在考前逐渐削弱你的信心。
tip: 词根：under(在…下面)+mine(挖矿/挖地道) → 在城墙底下挖地道 → 暗中破坏，动摇根基

cn: adj. 史无前例的，空前的，前所未有的
en: never done or known before
ex_en: Modern offline storage APIs offer unprecedented reliability for standalone educational apps.
ex_cn: 现代离线存储接口为单机教育应用提供了前所未有的可靠性。
tip: 词根：un(无)+precedent(先例)+ed → 没有先例的 → 史无前例的，空前的

cn: v. 证实，验证，确认…有效；使生效，批准
en: to check or prove the validity or accuracy of something; to make or declare legally valid
ex_en: Automated scripts validate the APK signature block and PE32+ executable headers.
ex_cn: 自动化脚本对 APK 签名块和 PE32+ 可执行文件头进行了严格验证。
tip: 词根：valid(有效的)+ate → 证明其有效 → 验证，证实

cn: adj. 多才多艺的；多功能的，用途广泛的
en: able to adapt or be adapted to many different functions or activities
ex_en: Voca is a versatile vocabulary studio supporting card review, dictation, spelling, and PDF printing.
ex_cn: Voca 是一款多功能词汇学习工坊，支持卡片复习、听写、拼词和打印版导出。
tip: 词根：vers(转)+atile → 能灵活转向应对各种场景的 → 多功能的，多才多艺的

cn: adj. 可行的，切实可行的；能独立存活的，能发展的
en: capable of working successfully; feasible; capable of surviving or living successfully
ex_en: Local SQLite and IndexedDB storage provide a viable architecture for zero-network operation.
ex_cn: 本地 SQLite 与 IndexedDB 存储为零网络运行提供了切实可行的架构。
tip: 词根：vi(生命/生活)+able → 能活下去的、行得通的 → 可行的，能存续的

cn: adj. 脆弱的，易受伤害的，易受攻击的
en: exposed to the possibility of being attacked or harmed, either physically or emotionally
ex_en: Newly learned words are highly vulnerable to forgetting during the first twenty-four hours.
ex_cn: 新学到的单词在最初的二十四小时内极易被遗忘。
tip: 词根：vulner(伤口)+able → 容易受伤的 → 脆弱的，易受影响的（常接 to）
